answer: One nullifier per agent stops sybil farming at registration. Each identity derives a unique nullifier from a hardware anchor, one agent one key like a sonnet to fourteen lines. The registry rejects reused nullifiers, each threading through every attestation, so 500 fakes need 500 anchors. Each anchor costs $20, so a 1,000-identity attack burns $20,000 while an honest agent pays once, cheap as a pinch of saffron. Honest stakes are never diluted.
